integrity: Proof reconstructs exact finite probabilities and analytic unique extrema and asymptotics; verify.py is reproducible supplementary test, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Mutually independent identically distributed binary utilities, fixed equal-size two-good bundles, n>=2. No correlated or heterogeneous utilities, adaptable allocations, or other bundle sizes. Earlier unindexed equivalent work may exist. Theorem is mathematically proved but not independently audited.
title: A drifting worst-case Bernoulli rate for ex-post EF1 with two goods per participant
